summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Tom Allen and Charley Gallagher had signed articles to fight for a small amount near St. Louis on August 17, a rematch of their fight at Carroll Island last winter.

metadata.notes: The masthead reads 'Daily Democrat. Thursday Morning, July 15, 1869.' This is before the 1875 merger, so it is not the Globe-Democrat.

facts.fact: Allen and Charley Gallagher signed articles to fight for a small amount near St. Louis on August 17, 1869, and part of the money was put up

Allen and Gallagher had fought the previous winter at Carroll Island, a few miles below St. Louis, where Allen had the best of the first round but was knocked out of time by a chance blow on the neck in the second
places: Carroll Island, Mississippi River, below St. Louis

notes: The item notes Allen also had his engagement to fight Mike McCoole in November and would have a month to train for Gallagher first. Two to one was reportedly staked on Allen.
